messages:
chris: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — capturing owners and short due dates so nothing falls off. dropping checklist here. :spiral_note_pad:
priya: i'll own the handshake + server backoff changes. plan: short-lived nonce + jittered retries. due: 2026-04-09.
mike: i'll own metrics + alerts: partial-response ratio, p95 stream latency, per-region panels. due: 2026-04-05.
lee: infra: i'll enable jemalloc on the canary stream pods and run GC tuning. due: 2026-04-06.
tara: client-side: i'll add an onResume callback and small buffer example in node+python. due: 2026-04-04.
priya: server backoff prototype: ```json
{"retries":3,"backoff_ms":[200,700,2500],"handshake_ttl_s":60}
```
mike: draft promql for partials: `sum(increase(chat_stream_partial_total[10m])) / sum(increase(chat_stream_request_total[10m])) > 0.05` — alert with runbook link + region labels.
chris: ops mitigation: infra to expose a toggle to route to fallback-small model when error rate >4% for 15m. @engbot create action.
engbot: /action created: model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release) — interval:60s ttl:1h
priya: i'll add a compatibility matrix for SDKs and gate with a feature flag. fallback for old SDKs -> non-stream flow.
lee: will canary jemalloc and report memory/latency deltas here.
chris: action summary (ISO dates): priya 2026-04-09, mike 2026-04-05, lee 2026-04-06, tara 2026-04-04. please update tracker rows when you change status. i'll convene a closure check next Mon.
